title: Multi-page scroll-back: each additional load-older hop goes one page further, not the same page again
action: User field-test finding (2026-07-28), after confirming the redraw-race fixes worked (drag-scroll gesture also confirmed working): repeated 'load older' always revealed the same one page back, never further, because every request restored the pane to live before returning -- there was no way to ask for 'further back than last time'. User explicitly asked to skip exploring/planning ceremony and implement directly (gate_bypass already full). Design (stateless, no new durable server state, matching this repo's never-store-terminal-output convention): the client tracks its own running depth (historyDepth, resets to 0 on return-to-live) and asks for one more hop each time via `?history=<n>` (the n=1 shape is unchanged/back-compat). PaneScroller::read_history/read_history_with_strategy now take a `pages` count and loop that many PageUp-hops in one round trip, judging each hop's completion against the PREVIOUS hop's own content (not a fixed original baseline) before always restoring to live exactly as before -- fully self-contained per request, no risk of a pane left scrolled if the client drops off mid-browse.

truths: requesting pages=N sends N PageUp hops in one round trip, each judged against the previous hop's content
a request for more pages than the agent actually has stops early without erroring (later hops are no-ops once nothing richer comes back)
the pane is always restored to live at the end regardless of how many pages were hopped
the frontend's historyDepth increments on each successful load-older while still viewing history, and resets to 0 on any return to live

artifacts.substantive: read_history/read_history_with_strategy take a pages: usize param and loop hops; 2 new tests for pages>1 and pages-beyond-available
escape_reveal (single Option<String>) generalized to escape_pages (Vec<String>) + scroll_index + push_escape_page seam, gated by ever_scrolled
ScreenQuery.history parsed as the hop count (?history=<n>), falling back to 1 for a non-numeric/legacy value
fetchScreen's history boolean generalized to historyPages: number
historyDepth tracked, incremented on each successful loadOlder(), reset to 0 wherever viewingHistory clears back to live
mock routing/assertions generalized from the literal history=1 substring to history= (any depth); new regression test for depth accumulation and reset

key_links: frontend historyDepth and backend pages are the same number, just named for their own side of the request
prohibitions: no new durable per-pane server-side state between requests
no change to the always-restore-to-live guarantee
